QUOTE: `mbedtls_ct_compiler_opaque()` (`constant_time_impl.h:85-93`) wraps values in `asm volatile("" : "+r"(x))` so the compiler cannot prove a value and fold the mask back into a branch.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer names mbedtls_ct_compiler_opaque as the barrier that stops the compiler from knowing a value and places it in constant_time_impl.h.
